observations: Photo 0: one low resolution shot of a white desktop laser printer with a flatbed scanner lid on top, so a multifunction printer, stacked on another box.
The printer is wrapped in clear plastic with newspaper and a Pepsi advert sheet stuffed inside the wrap, the usual packing for imported used printers.
A blue HP style logo shows on a printed sheet at the upper left inside the wrap; it is not clearly on the printer body itself.
No model name, control panel, screen, page count report or rating plate is visible; the front output slot and paper tray are closed.
A dealer watermark (ACHANOS ... NIG LTD) is across the photo.
Seller text is copied manufacturer marketing, not a description of this unit.

read_from: photo 0 HP logo on a printed sheet inside the wrap, not confirmed on the body; no model text legible

Marketing copy for a model line; speed cannot be judged from a photo and the model is not shown.
